Data:V.wound.json.label: Visitor: the Affair of the Open Reverend
Data:V.wound.json.desc: Visited Hush House on business connected with the Open Reverend.

xexts.scrutiny: Gathered along the river's edge, touched still by the river's memory.

Data:Vase.gorse.json.Label: Vase of Gorse
Data:Vase.gorse.json.Desc: As Cornish a plant as any.

xexts.scrutiny: For the dead; but not only for the dead.
A local reproduction; but a good one.
'Should this fair rose offend thine eye/Raised to the troubled air/'Twill blush to find itself less white/And turn Lancastrian there.' - Somerville, approximately

Data:Veg.basket.apples.json.Label: Basket of Apples
Data:Veg.basket.apples.json.Desc: Notoriously hard to take just one bite.

Data:Veg.basket.leeks.json.Label: Basket of Leeks
Data:Veg.basket.leeks.json.Desc: The mark of St David's triumph. And very good in soup.

xexts.scrutiny: That wasn't what you'd call easy on the palate.

Data:Veg.basket.onions.json.Label: Basket of Onions
Data:Veg.basket.onions.json.Desc: The prima materia of cooking. This may be why the cosmos is shaped so like an onion.

xexts.scrutiny: That wasn't what you'd call easy on the palate.

Data:Veg.marrow.acrid.json.Label: Acrid Marrow
Data:Veg.marrow.acrid.json.Desc: In Brancrug, they take marrows seriously. This is not a marrow conducive to harmony.

Data:Veg.marrow.dark.json.Label: Dark Marrow
Data:Veg.marrow.dark.json.Desc: In Brancrug, they take marrows seriously. This is a marrow with secrets.

xexts.scrutiny: The secrets in this marrow are not identifiable to the tongue.

Data:Veg.marrow.golden.json.Label: Golden Marrow
Data:Veg.marrow.golden.json.Desc: In Brancrug, they take marrows seriously. This is accounted a beauty among its kind.

xexts.scrutiny: This marrow's magnificence is not manifest in the mouth.

Data:Veg.marrow.pale.json.Label: Pale Marrow
Data:Veg.marrow.pale.json.Desc: In Brancrug, they take marrows seriously. This is a marrow redolent of sorrow.

xexts.scrutiny: Eating it raw only accentuates the sorrow.

Data:Venue.formal.json.label: Formal Venue
Data:Venue.formal.json.desc: A suitable location for Lunch or Supper.

Data:Venue.informal.json.label: Informal Venue
Data:Venue.informal.json.desc: A suitable location for Elevenses or Afternoon Tea.

Data:Venue.picnicking.json.label: Picknicking Venue
Data:Venue.picnicking.json.desc: A suitable location for a Picnic.

Data:Village.invite.denzil.block.hint.js.label: Not Just Now -
Data:Village.invite.denzil.block.hint.js.startdescription: [You can't invite Denzil to a Salon if you've already invited a villager or already held a Salon this Season.]

Data:Village.invite.denzil.json.label: Invite the Blacksmith to Hush House
Data:Village.invite.denzil.json.startdescription: Invite Denzil up to Hush House.
Data:Village.invite.denzil.json.desc: Denzil inclines his head in thanks. [Denzil has sent a gift ahead.]

Data:Village.invite.killes.block.hint.js.label: Not Just Now -
Data:Village.invite.killes.block.hint.js.startdescription: [You can't invite the Killes to a Salon if you've already invited a villager or already held a Salon this Season.]

Data:Village.invite.killes.json.label: Invite the Killes to Hush House
Data:Village.invite.killes.json.startdescription: Invite the Killes up to Hush House.
Data:Village.invite.killes.json.desc: Mr Kille is clearly excited, and remains courteous. Mrs Kille is courteous, and may be excited: as ever, it's difficult to tell. [The Killes have sent a gift ahead.]

Data:Village.invite.timothy.block.hint.j.label: Not Just Now -
Data:Village.invite.timothy.block.hint.j.startdescription: [You can't invite Timothy to a Salon if you've already invited a villager or already held a Salon this Season.]

Data:Village.invite.timothy.json.label: Invite the Rector to a Salon
Data:Village.invite.timothy.json.startdescription: Invite Reverend Timothy up to Hush House.
Data:Village.invite.timothy.json.desc: Reverend Timothy is almost speechless with excitement... almost. [Timothy has sent a gift ahead.]

Data:Village.killes.closed.json.label: Mrs and Mr Kille [Locked]
Data:Village.killes.closed.json.desc: Mrs Kille the midwife is tall and gloomy. Mr Kille the undertaker is slight and wry. In these troubled times, both are wary of strangers. [You need a suitably marked Introduction; check the slot.]

slot.label: The Front Room
slot.description: I need a mutual acquaintance to introduce me to the Killes - someone of stature, or someone who shares their interests.

Data:Village.killes.open.friend.json.label: Mrs and Mr Kille
Data:Village.killes.open.friend.json.desc: Mrs Kille the midwife is tall and gloomy. Mr Kille the undertaker is slight and wry. For ten years she has drawn villagers into the world and he has shaped cradles for their departure. But she can also whittle, and he can also paint.

slot.label: The Front Room
slot.description: The Killes put the kettle on when they see you coming down the street.

Data:Village.killes.open.json.label: Mrs and Mr Kille
Data:Village.killes.open.json.desc: Mrs Kille the midwife is tall and gloomy. Mr Kille the undertaker is slight and wry. For ten years she has drawn villagers into the world and he has shaped cradles for their departure. But she can also whittle, and he can also paint.

Data:Village.postoffice.closed.json.label: The Post Office [Locked]
Data:Village.postoffice.closed.json.desc: The postmistress may have something for me - once I know what to ask for.

slot.label: Post Office Counter
slot.description: A place of power, a place of knowledge, beneath the sheltering hand of his Majesty the King.

Data:Village.postoffice.open.json.label: Post Office
Data:Village.postoffice.open.json.desc: The Postmistress keeps the gate to the wider world. In her left hand is the lightning (which is to say, the telegraph) and in her right, the thunder (which is to say, the only telephone in Brancrug). Before her lies the cash-register, which accepteth the greater currency and returneth its lesser children.

slots.label: Offering
slots.description: What have you brought the Postmistress?

Data:Village.rectory.closed.json.label: The Rectory [Locked]
Data:Village.rectory.closed.json.desc:
Reverend Timothy is a hospitable soul, but Terrence, his housekeeper, guards her employer fiercely. She doesn't want his innocent theological enthusiasms getting him in trouble with the New King's men.
 [You need an Introduction, or a mutual acquaintance marked with Lantern, Knock, or Sky -  perhaps someone who shares his interests in theology or poetry.]

slot.label: Front Steps
slot.description: I need a mutual acquaintance to introduce me to Reverend Timothy - perhaps someone who shares his interests in theology or poetry.

Data:Village.rectory.open.friend.json.label: The Rectory
Data:Village.rectory.open.friend.json.desc: Reverend Timothy's words always run ahead of him, but his thoughts always catch up.

slot.label: The Study
slot.description: Reverend Timothy is always pleased to see you.

Data:Village.rectory.open.json.label: The Rectory
Data:Village.rectory.open.json.desc: Reverend Timothy's words always run ahead of him, but his thoughts always catch up in the end.

Data:Village.smithy.closed.json.label: The Smithy [Locked]
Data:Village.smithy.closed.json.desc:
Denzil Smith has more work than he needs, and he rarely opens his door to strangers.
[You need an Introduction, or a mutual acquaintance marked with Edge, Forge, or Heart - someone in a similar trade, or someone who can appeal to his secret passion for saffron cake.]

slot.label: A Smoky Room
slot.description: I need a mutual acquaintance to introduce me to Denzil - someone in a similar trade, or someone who can appeal to his secret passion for saffron cake.

Data:Village.smithy.open.friend.json.label: The Smithy
Data:Village.smithy.open.friend.json.desc: Denzil Smith, strong as oak, blackened by smoke. He will never surpass his father, and he is no longer a soldier. But he still has his craft.

slot.label: A Smoky Room
slot.description: Denzil doesn't smile when he welcomes you in, but that's only because he's Denzil.
